items.label: Early Risk-Off — VIX 24.93
items.detail: VIX at 24.93, regime score 0.51. SPX at 6,781 below 50DMA. Defensive rotation into gold, staples, materials. Only 32% of stocks positive on Tuesday.

items.label: Iran War Day 11 — Strait of Hormuz Risk
items.detail: US-Iran conflict enters Day 11. Oil spiked to $120 Monday, crashed to $84 on ceasefire hopes. Hormuz effectively blocked. Both sides escalating rhetoric. Resolution = oil $65-70 rally. Escalation = oil $100+ stagflation.

items.label: CPI February — Thursday March 13
items.detail: February CPI is the week's dominant macro event. Consensus: core +0.3% MoM. Hot print reignites stagflation fears. Cool print reconfirms 2-cut narrative for 2026.

items.label: IEA Record Oil Reserve Release Proposed
items.detail: IEA proposes largest strategic reserve release in 50-year history to cap oil prices amid Iran war. WTI dropped from $120 to $84. Temporary supply bridge, not structural solution.

items.label: Oracle Q3 Blowout — +10% After Hours
items.detail: Oracle Q3: revenue $17.2B (+22%), cloud $8.9B (+44%), RPO $553B (+325%). FY27 guidance raised to $90B. Best quarter in 15 years. Potential catalyst for cloud/AI sector Wednesday.

items.label: Trade War — SCOTUS Ruling + Tariff Cuts
items.detail: SCOTUS ruled IEEPA tariffs unconstitutional. US-China tariffs cut 145%→30% (US), 125%→10% (China). Canada/Mexico USMCA exemptions to April 2. Implementation risks remain.

items.label: TLT Under Pressure — Bonds Selling Off
items.detail: TLT -1.06%. Bond market signaling inflation fears ahead of CPI. 30-Year yield at 4.771%. Rising yields compete with equity dividends.

items.label: FOMC Meeting — March 18-19
items.detail: Next FOMC meeting March 18-19. No rate change expected but dot plot and SEP projections will reflect tariff/inflation uncertainty.

items.label: Fed Chair Powell Term Ends — May 2026
items.detail: Jerome Powell's term expires May 15, 2026. Nomination battle will drive rate expectations. Hawkish replacement = bond selloff risk.

items.label: Earnings Wave — DG, ULTA, DOCU, RBRK Wed
items.detail: Wednesday: Dollar General, Ulta Beauty, DocuSign, Rubrik, D-Wave (QBTS), Wheaton Precious Metals. PayPay IPO. Key test for consumer and tech sentiment.

items.label: Gold at $5,206 — Safe Haven Bid
items.detail: Gold holding above $5,200 despite 0.68% pullback. Iran conflict + DXY weakness + central bank buying provide structural support. Scanner picks: NEM (score 91), GDX (score 90).

items.label: BBIO — Triple Analyst Upgrade
items.detail: BridgeBio Pharma surged +13.2% on 3 upgrades (Barclays, William Blair, JPM target $89). Score 92/100. Drug manufacturers leading industry rotation.

items.label: Oracle — Cloud/AI Growth Re-Rating
items.detail: ORCL +10% AH on blowout earnings. Cloud +44%, RPO +325%. Potential catalyst for entire cloud/AI sector. Entry on gap-fill pullback to $168-172.

items.label: Materials Sector Leading Rotation
items.detail: Materials #1 sector. Gold miners, precious metals, coking coal top industries. Scanner picks: NEM, RIO, GDX. Defensive growth in risk-off regime.

items.label: Consumer Staples — Defensive Rotation
items.detail: XLP outperforming in risk-off. KR near 52-week high. Scanner picks: KR (score 88), XLP (score 86). Quality defensive play.

items.label: DXY Below 99 — Dollar Structural Decline
items.detail: Dollar at 98.77. EUR/USD 1.1636. Supports gold, EM equities, commodities. Structural weakness from tariff uncertainty and trade deal concessions.

items.label: Software Sector Carnage — AI Disruption Fear
items.detail: INTU -30% YTD, CRM -26%, NOW -23%. Investors reassessing software valuations amid AI disruption fears. Even companies beating earnings are getting sold.

items.label: EU Fiscal Stimulus Ongoing
items.detail: Germany EUR 500B infrastructure fund + EU defense spending. DAX +2.39% today. Structural catalyst for European equities.

items.label: Asia Rebounding — KOSPI +3.5%
items.detail: KOSPI surged 3.5%, Nikkei +2.1%. Samsung and SK Hynix leading on AI chip demand. Broad Asia risk-on on oil relief and US-China trade progress.

items.label: Bitcoin $69.5K — Range-Bound
items.detail: Bitcoin flat at $69,552. 50DMA at $95,678 far above. Still -72% from 52-week high. Macro correlated with DXY weakness. Waiting for catalyst.

items.label: US Debt Ceiling — Late Q2 2026
items.detail: Treasury extraordinary measures expected to run out by June-July 2026. Political brinkmanship risk. Credit downgrade potential.

items.label: China-Taiwan Tensions — Ongoing
items.detail: Military exercises around Taiwan remain elevated. Any escalation would shock semis supply chain. Tail risk for tech sector.

items.label: US Midterm Elections — November 2026
items.detail: Congressional midterms in November 2026. Historical pattern: markets rally post-midterms. Pre-election volatility typically begins Q3.
